project.name: Prepared tetrahedral FL states and the volume crossover
project.subtitle: Five explicitly constructed K=4 FL references: equal input face areas, phi=90,60,30,10,0 degrees. Saved face-spin distributions, pair correlations, angular fluctuations, volume distributions and overlaps; comparisons with the first three energy groups of complete/ring Hamiltonians at t=1,U=20. The complete ground is kernel-dominated despite nearly unit four-face weight.
